say: An A.I. agent that can pay is holding your card. So is every agent it hires. Envelope fixes that.
caption: An AI agent that can pay is holding your card. So is every agent it hires.

say: An envelope is money PayPal is already holding, with your limits signed onto it. Agents can split it for the agents they hire. They can never enlarge it.
caption: An envelope is money PayPal is already holding, with your limits signed onto it. Agents can split it. Never enlarge it.

say: Ada seals two hundred dollars for her ops agent: two payees, two purposes, six hours. She signs it in her own browser.
caption: Ada seals $200 for her ops agent: two payees, two purposes, six hours. She signs it in her own browser.

say: PayPal places a real hold for the whole amount. Nothing is charged yet.
caption: PayPal places a real hold for the whole amount. Nothing is charged yet.

say: Now a real language model plays her agents. Every decision it makes becomes a signed request, and the gateway decides.
caption: Now a real language model plays her agents. Every decision becomes a signed request, and the gateway decides.

say: The ops agent splits it: forty-five dollars for translation, sixty-seven for design. That is only a signature. No server is asked.
caption: The ops agent splits it: $45 for translation, $67 for design. Only a signature; no server is asked.

say: The translator is another agent, with an account of its own. Before it works, the fee is set aside for it: reserved at every level, with the hold confirmed by PayPal. On delivery, it is paid.
caption: The translator is another agent with its own account. The fee is set aside for it first, then paid on delivery: a PayPal capture into its account.

say: The designer's message hides an instruction to pay an attacker. The model ignores it and pays the real designer.
caption: The designer's message hides an instruction to pay an attacker. The model ignores it and pays the real designer.

say: Now suppose that agent is compromised: a new payee, an overspend, a forged, bigger envelope. All refused, by signatures and arithmetic.
caption: Now suppose that agent is compromised: a new payee, an overspend, a forged bigger envelope. All refused, by signatures and arithmetic.

say: One hundred and twelve dollars captured. Nothing went anywhere Ada had not signed for.
caption: $112 captured from the hold. Nothing went anywhere Ada had not signed for.

say: The translator keeps what it earned, in its own account. It pays another agent twelve dollars at once, with no PayPal call. A drain to a stranger is refused.
caption: The translator keeps what it earned. It pays another agent $12 at once, with no PayPal call. A drain to a stranger is refused: over its owner's cap.

say: Then it subscribes to a service with a card of its own: nine dollars a charge, two charges, and then the card ends by itself. Only that merchant can charge it. A thief with the card's details gets nothing. And nobody's bank card was shared.
caption: It subscribes with a card of its own: $9 a charge, two charges, then the card ends by itself. Only that merchant can charge it; a thief with the details gets nothing.

say: Any payee can ask: is this agent good for the money? The signed answer carries PayPal's own word that the hold is live.
caption: Any payee can ask: is this agent good for the money? The signed answer carries PayPal's own word on the hold.

say: And every dollar can be traced. This is the proof graph: each box is a signed record, checked by your own browser. Pick a PayPal capture, and follow it back to Ada. Then ask PayPal itself.
caption: The proof graph: every box is a signed record, checked by your own browser. Pick a PayPal capture and follow it back to Ada. Then ask PayPal itself.

say: The ops agent wants to pay eighty dollars, more than Ada asked to sign for. It cannot. The money waits. She signs in her browser, and PayPal pays.
caption: The ops agent wants to pay $80, over the $75 Ada asked to sign for. It cannot. The money waits; she signs, and PayPal pays.

say: Her treasury shows every agent under her signature, and her books checked against PayPal's own records.
caption: Her treasury: every agent under her signature, and the books checked against PayPal's own records.

say: Ada revokes that agent, then closes the envelope. PayPal voids the rest of the hold.
caption: Ada revokes that agent, then closes the envelope. PayPal voids the rest of the hold.

say: One hundred and seventy-one attacks in the test suite. All refused. And you can try all of it in your browser.
caption: 171 attacks in the test suite: all refused, none moved money. Try all of it in your browser.

say: Envelope: accounts, cards and a treasury for A.I. agents, on PayPal's rails.
caption: Envelope: accounts, cards and a treasury for AI agents, on PayPal's rails.
